components.extended_description: Store Pythoine is Suite Pythoine’s optional headless catalogue, content and acquisition backend. Suite owns the visible Store, trusted application identity, installed state and managed installation; Store supplies versioned local enrichment, explicit online refresh and verified package acquisition.
highlights: Headless backend with Suite Pythoine as the only user-facing Store interface
Offline-first local content with explicit HTTPS catalogue refresh
Verified package acquisition using published SHA-256 before Suite installation
components.release_notes: 0.0.3-exp1 retires the standalone Store window and presentation preferences. Store Pythoine now exposes only the headless publish, explicit online-refresh and verified-acquisition operations consumed by Suite Pythoine 0.11-exp6.0.
